items.prompt: Optimistic atompunk city in an alternate history: a 1950s world that discovered atomic power centuries ago, so its culture and style are 1950s but its technology is centuries ahead: 1950s-styled robots, trams and street furniture doing super-advanced things. Atomic power made energy, travel and building cheap: sky rail, skyports, towers and liners, everything physical abundant. Thinking machines and networks never came: robots are clockwork-smart on fixed routines, and records are physical (microfilm, punch cards, pneumatic tubes, stamped forms). An abundant, orderly city that runs on routine and paperwork. City: Streamline Moderne, Art Deco and Googie. Cream limestone and ivory enamel buildings with seafoam-teal faience bands, chrome sphere finials, banners on lamp posts, planted terraces, cypress and palms, parasol café terraces, pale cream stone paving with seafoam inlay bands, soft lilac-grey asphalt, brushed brass-gold trim lines and bands, coral, peach and mustard accents, enamel red and royal blue accents. Warm afternoon sun, soft shadows, soft blue sky. Prosperous and graceful. Game play camera: high view about 38 degrees looking down, near-orthographic (no strong perspective convergence), framed like a real-time tactics game. The cafe square by day. Keep the layout and buildings of the attached game frame: the curved streamline cafe with its orange-and-cream striped awning and checkerboard interior, red-and-cream parasol tables, the round fountain with a chrome orbit sculpture inside seafoam-teal paving rings, curved planters, lamp posts with green banners, the powder-blue road and rounded kerb at left. Only a few small distant figures, or none. ATMOSPHERE DIRECTION: 1950s comic-book print. Rendered like a printed 1950s comic or pulp magazine panel: confident black ink outlines of varying weight around buildings and props, flat cel-shaded colour in two or three tones per surface, halftone and Ben-Day dot screens in the shadows, the sky and the mid-tones, a slightly off-register colour print (cyan, magenta and yellow plates nudged a pixel or two), warm newsprint-paper ground showing through the highlights. Optimistic, clean graphic shapes. No speech balloons, captions, panel borders or lettering. Avoid: large gold panels, glass curtain walls, grime, text, signage lettering or words, present-day street furniture, 1950s period dress: fedoras, trilbies, tea dresses, Americana, photographic realism, glossy wet reflections, bloom, close-up people. Landscape 16:9.
